profile.headline: 3D CAD/Geometry Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With over fifteen years of experience in developing extremely complex engineering software products, a highly motivated professional with advanced background in mechanical engineering and geometry/mathematics is looking for opportunities to tackle even more interesting computational and engineering challenges. 

Specialties include: Solid modeling, filleting, reverse engineering (point cloud), sheet metal, BRep/NURBS-based parametric modeling, feature-based modeling, surfaces and curves, and other geometry- and topology-related concepts and algorithms. Excellent communication skills; fluent in multiple languages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as part of an Agile Squad team responsible for enhancing and maintaining the core functionality of a composite material simulation software called FiberSIM:

Worked on the initial implementation of a new forming simulation product module. Helped define, design and implement the UI, workflow, and geometry-related functionality of the simulation software, including mesh post-processing. Also implemented automated tests as part of the Agile-based development duties. 

Helped streamline user experience and functionality of simulation data export to client composite material layup machines. 

Helped implement new boundary geometry representation for increased simulation data integrity for downstream applications.

positions.title: Senior/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a member of a core solid modeling kernel development group on diverse projects that placed heavy emphasis on mechanical engineering and geometry/mathematical knowledge using complex problem solving skills:

-Shared responsibilities for the fillet engine, a vital component of the ZW solid modeling kernel. Notable work included implementing advanced tracing solutions for such cases as hold-line variable radius and tight radius regions as well as enhancements for many cases of corner resolution. Also helped implement replacement fillet generation method for modified parts via “Direct Modeling” tools.

-Primarily responsible for designing and developing a new reverse engineering suite of tools, including a surface blending function utilizing FEM and energy minimization methods, point cloud data reduction, and STL/tessellated data partitioning methods.

-Was solely responsible for advising junior developers in all phases of enhancing and maintaining a sheet metal design suite including project design, implementation, and testing. Also conducted code reviews and helped prioritize user requirements based on technical feasibility. 

-Helped improve and maintain multiple aspects of the core geometry and topology kernel and the CAD database functionality, as well as enhancing various feature-level tools.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Helped implement a next generation fillet engine and completed the switch-over from the existing one.

-Designed, implemented and maintained a reverse engineering module, including a new work flow model. Integrated a point cloud data tessellation library and developed tessellated data traversal methods to support higher-level scanned data partitioning functionality.

-Overhauled, enhanced, and maintained a sheet metal design suite, including fold/unfold operations, several types of flanges and other sheet metal specific features, as well as improved support for imported geometry.

-Enhanced and maintained numerous shape/feature/free-form surface tools such as solid shell/draft, threaded holes/external threads, n-sided/blended/curve-mesh patches, among others.

-Designed and enhanced CAD database objects.

-Worked on wire-frame, 2D drafting, dimensioning, and constraint system functionality.

-Contributed code to mold design tools.

positions.title: Graduate assistant coordinator
positions.description: -Helped obtain grant for a next generation visual computing equipment  from HP Co.

company.name: eMedia Center/Model Advanced Facility - The University of Wisconsin - Madison

positions.title: Teacing/Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Developed the theory of CAD-based design for disassembly methodology and implemented a proof of concept using a commercial CAD development tool kit.

-Taught introductory graphics and solid modeling classes.

projects.title: Master's Thesis
projects.description: Developed a methodology that determined ways of modifying a CAD assembly for more efficient disassembly and generated a corresponding disassembly sequence. Research included inventive use of topology information utilizing an existing solid modeling kernel, heuristic evaluation of disassembly solutions, and basic life-cycle/cost analysis of mechanical disassembly.

publications.title: Destructive Disassembly to Support Virtual Prototyping
Computer Aided Design for Disassembly: A Destructive Approach
publications.publisher: International Symposium on Electronics and the Environment (IEEE) · May 1, 1996
